source_title: Stop sermonising others; introspect why BJP lost Varanasi seats in MLC polls: Congress slams PM
source_excerpt: New Delhi The Congress on Thursday (October 29, 2026) hit back at Prime Minister Narendra Modi over his taunt at the Opposition party's showing in the MLC elections, saying he must stop trolling and sermonising others and instead reflect on why the BJP lost both seats in his own Parliamentary Constituency of Varanasi. https://www.thehindu.com/topic/indian-national-congress/ https://www.thehindu.com/topic/Narendra_Modi/ https://www.thehindu.com/topic/bharatiya-janata-party/ Congress general secretary in-charge communications Jairam Ramesh said that from Varanasi and Nagpur to Lucknow, Prayagraj, and Patna, the people have clearly passed a "no-confidence motion against" the PM's policies. PM questions Congress over party’s MLC election results PM questions Congress over party’s MLC election results ‘MLC elections in 28 seats across four big States — Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Bihar and Karnataka. Elections held using ballot papers. Guess how many seats Congress won? said Narendra Modi in a post on X PM questions Congress over party’s MLC election results storyline 1 "The Prime Minister needs to introspect, but instead, he's sermonising others! Before counting Congress's seats, I wish he'd also reflect on why the BJP lost both seats in his own parliamentary constituency of Varanasi, and how Congress managed to defeat the BJP in RSS's stronghold of Nagpur?" Mr. Ramesh said in his post in Hindi on X. "Mr. Modi, stop the trolling. Crores of families are reeling from back-breaking inflation, the youth are unemployed, and private investment has ground to a halt," he said. Drop the arrogance and reflect on these issues, Mr. Ramesh said. Maharashtra MLC election: Congress trumps BJP in Nagpur, MVA leads 3-2 in State Maharashtra MLC election: Congress trumps BJP in Nagpur, MVA leads 3-2 in State While the NCP SP called for going back to ballot papers for holding elections, the BJP called for introspection among the alliance partners Maharashtra MLC election: Congress trumps BJP in Nagpur, MVA leads 3-2 in State storyline 1 "From Varanasi and Nagpur to Lucknow, Prayagraj, and Patna, the people have clearly passed a no-confidence motion against your policies," the Congress leader said. The Congress on Wednesday (October 28, 2026) had hit back at Prime Minister Modi over his taunt, saying that if the PM is so confident that EVMs have no bearing on election results, he should prove his confidence in the BJP's electoral prowess through action, not rhetoric. The Congress said if the PM believes that EVMs have no bearing on the election results then he should commit to conducting all Lok Sabha and upcoming Vidhan Sabha elections by ballot paper, going forward. Bihar MLC polls: Upper caste candidates dominate election results Bihar MLC polls: Upper caste candidates dominate election results The Opposition Congress party which had put up its candidates on five seats has failed to win even a single seat in the elections Bihar MLC polls: Upper caste candidates dominate election results storyline 1 The Opposition party's assertion came after Prime Minister Modi taunted the Congress for its dismal show in the MLC elections despite the use of paper ballots, a key demand of Opposition parties in their campaign against EVMs. The BJP and its NDA allies won 16 of the 28 seats in the Legislative Council elections held across four States, as the Congress won one, while the Samajwadi Party emerged winner in five seats in Uttar Pradesh, including two in Varanasi.
